style: Mandarin, piano pop, warm lead vocal, piano and soft drums
lyrics:
[Verse]
晨光落在窗边
风吹过安静的街
我们带着昨天的梦
走向新的一天
[Chorus]
让歌声陪伴你
穿过雨后的天际
每一次轻轻呼吸
都听见新的勇气

style: English, melodic rock, expressive lead vocal, electric guitar, bass and drums
lyrics:
[Verse]
We follow the road by the river
We carry the light through the rain
The echoes of yesterday linger
But morning is calling again
[Chorus]
Raise your voice into the sunlight
Let the quiet mountains sing
Every step becomes a promise
Every day a new beginning

style: English, gentle jazz, warm lead vocal, piano, upright bass and brushed drums
lyrics:
[Verse]
A paper moon above the bay
The city slowly fades away
Your footsteps find a softer time
A passing train becomes a rhyme
[Chorus]
Stay until the stars are waking
Let the evening wander free
Every note the night is making
Brings a little light to me
